items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21

ctx.x: I never knew him either. Yeah, he lived on this side. Do you know his, any other name that he had? Was that his first name or last name? No, it was Valto. Do you remember Moody, anything about his name? No.
Valto, that's all I know is Valto. You take, uh, the violin player back up in there, who that was? Uh, no. Jimmy Polar in there, man. Over the river there. But he was living over the river. Yeah.
The old man Ullett, he was living over here. Yeah, yeah, yeah. Yeah, yeah.
